# How much of your health insurance can you deduct?

> Free self-employed health insurance deduction calculator. Enter net profit and premiums to see the Schedule 1 deduction after the profit ceiling, employer-plan months and long-term-care caps, and the income tax it saves. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
